Problem Statement
Read the length and breadth of a rectangle, then print its area and perimeter.
Description
A rectangle has a length and a breadth. Read these two values, then find and print the area and the perimeter of the rectangle.
Input Description
Two integers, the length and the breadth, each on a separate line. (1 <= length, breadth <= 1000)
Output Description
Print the area on the first line and the perimeter on the second line. Print only the numbers.
